column4: 他们在推广一种新手机。
column5: They are promoting a new kind of phone.
column6: 推广 is to spread something widely or to promote it: 推广经验 (to spread experience), 推广新产品 (to promote a new product).

column4: 你能给我推荐一本好书吗？
column5: Can you recommend a good book to me?
column6: 推荐 is to recommend: 推荐一本书 (to recommend a book), 推荐给朋友 (to recommend to a friend).

column5: This work is moving forward very fast.
column6: 推进 is to push work or a plan forward step by step: 推进工作 (to push work forward), 推进计划 (to move a plan forward).

column5: These shoes are too small; I want to return them.
column6: 退 is to move back or to give something back: 往后退 (to step back), 退票 (to return a ticket), 退钱 (to give money back).

column4: 他因为受伤退出了比赛。
column5: He dropped out of the competition because of an injury.
column6: 退出 is to leave a group, a game or a contest: 退出比赛 (to drop out of a competition), 退出游戏 (to quit a game).

column5: The shop refunded my money.
column6: 退还 is to give something back to its owner, often money: 退还钱 (to refund money), 退还给他 (to give back to him).

column5: My dad retired this year.
column6: 退休 is to retire from work: 退休以后 (after retiring), 退休的老人 (a retired old person). It is a verb-object word.

column5: After coming in, please change into slippers.
column6: 拖鞋 are slippers: 一双拖鞋 (a pair of slippers), 换拖鞋 (to change into slippers).

column5: The outside of this building is very beautiful.
column6: 外部 is the outside of something: 外部的人 (people from outside), 楼的外部 (the outside of a building). The everyday word is 外面.

column4: 我外公住在上海，我常常去看他。
column5: My maternal grandfather lives in Shanghai, and I often go to see him.
column6: 外公 is your mother's father: 外公外婆 (maternal grandparents). Your father's father is 爷爷.

column5: The outward appearance of this car is very beautiful.
column6: 外观 is how a thing looks from outside: 外观漂亮 (a nice look), 外观设计 (the design of the exterior).

column5: The food my maternal grandmother makes is very tasty.
column6: 外婆 is your mother's mother: 外婆家 (your maternal grandmother's home). Your father's mother is 奶奶.

column4: 这个杯子的外形很特别。
column5: The shape of this cup is very special.
column6: 外形 is the outer shape of a thing: 外形好看 (a nice shape), 外形特别 (an unusual shape). It stresses the shape more than 外观 does.

column5: This road is curved.
column6: 弯 is curved, to bend, or a bend: 弯弯的 (curved), 一个弯 (a bend), 弯路 (a winding road).

column5: The child likes this new toy.
column6: 玩具 is a toy: 买玩具 (to buy a toy), 玩具车 (a toy car).

column5: This plan is perfect.
column6: 完美 is perfect, with no fault: 很完美 (very perfect), 完美的计划 (a perfect plan).

column5: We need to improve this plan.
column6: 完善 is to make something better and more complete (verb), or well developed (adjective): 完善计划 (to improve a plan), 很完善 (very complete).

column5: This book is complete.
column6: 完整 is complete, with nothing missing: 完整的句子 (a complete sentence), 完整的故事 (a whole story).

column5: If by any chance it rains, we will not go.
column6: 万一 is "in case, if by any chance", for something unlikely but possible: 万一下雨 (in case it rains), 万一有问题 (in case there is a problem).

column3: to go and return; round trip
column4: 去上海，往返要五个小时。
column5: A round trip to Shanghai takes five hours.
column6: 往返 is to go and come back: 往返票 (a round-trip ticket), 往返时间 (the round-trip time).

column5: The internet is very convenient now.
column6: 网络 is a network, or the internet: 网络游戏 (an online game), 网络很慢 (the network is slow).

column5: Smoking can harm one's health.
column6: 危害 is to harm something seriously: 危害健康 (to harm health), 危害安全 (to endanger safety).

column5: She looked at me and smiled.
column6: 微笑 is a smile (noun) or to smile (verb): 对他微笑 (to smile at him), 一个微笑 (a smile).

column4: 他威胁了我，让我不要告诉别人。
column5: He threatened me, telling me not to tell anyone.
column6: 威胁 is to threaten, or a threat: 威胁别人 (to threaten others), 一个威胁 (a threat).

column5: The children gather around the teacher.
column6: 围 is to surround or to gather around: 围在身边 (to gather around someone), 围起来 (to enclose).

column4: 他每天跑步，维持身体健康。
column5: He runs every day to maintain his good health.
column6: 维持 is to keep something going: 维持生活 (to make a living), 维持健康 (to keep good health).

column5: Making phone calls while driving is against the law.
column6: 违法 is to break the law, or illegal: 违法的事 (an illegal act), 不违法 (not against the law). It is a verb-object word.

column5: He broke the school's rules.
column6: 违反 is to go against a rule or a promise: 违反规定 (to break a rule), 违反交通规则 (to break the traffic rules).

column5: It got cold, so she put on a scarf.
column6: 围巾 is a scarf: 一条围巾 (a scarf), 戴围巾 (to wear a scarf).

column3: to go around; to focus on
column5: The earth goes around the sun.
column6: 围绕 is to go around something, or to focus on a topic: 围绕太阳 (around the sun), 围绕这个问题 (focusing on this question).

column5: This car needs repair.
column6: 维修 is to repair something and keep it in good order: 维修电脑 (to repair a computer), 维修店 (a repair shop).

column5: He is my only friend.
column6: 唯一 is "the only one": 唯一的办法 (the only way), 唯一的朋友 (the only friend).

column5: The puppy's tail is very short.
column6: 尾巴 is a tail: 一条尾巴 (a tail), 摇尾巴 (to wag the tail).

column5: He is a great teacher.
column6: 伟大 is great in an important way, for people, work and countries: 伟大的人 (a great person), 伟大的国家 (a great country). For plain "big", use 大.

column5: My stomach hurts a lot.
column6: 胃 is the stomach: 胃疼 (a stomachache), 胃不好 (a weak stomach).

column5: What job do you want to do in the future?
column6: 未来 is the future, a little more formal than 将来: 未来几年 (the next few years), 美好的未来 (a bright future).

column3: to be located in or at
column4: 这个城市位于中国的南方。
column5: This city is located in the south of China.
column6: 位于 is "to be located at", used in writing: 位于中国 (located in China), 位于山下 (at the foot of a mountain).

column5: Please tell me your location.
column6: 位置 is a location or a seat: 找位置 (to find a seat), 位置很好 (a good location).

column5: The sun in spring is very warm.
column6: 温暖 is warm in weather or in feeling, and also to warm someone: 温暖的家 (a warm home), 温暖了他的心 (warmed his heart).

column5: She likes Chinese literature.
column6: 文学 is literature: 中国文学 (Chinese literature), 学文学 (to study literature).

column5: His job is very stable.
column6: 稳定 is stable, not changing much: 稳定的工作 (a stable job), 价格稳定 (stable prices).

column5: Please fill in this questionnaire.
column6: 问卷 is a questionnaire: 填问卷 (to fill in a questionnaire), 一份问卷 (a questionnaire).

column5: He held my hand tightly.
column6: 握 is to hold in the hand: 握住 (to hold on to), 握紧 (to grip tightly), 握手 (to shake hands).

column4: 我的卧室不大，但是很干净。
column5: My bedroom is not big, but it is very clean.
column6: 卧室 is a bedroom: 我的卧室 (my bedroom), 卧室里 (in the bedroom).

column5: They shake hands when they meet.
column6: 握手 is a verb-object word: 跟他握手 (to shake hands with him), 互相握手 (to shake hands with each other).

column3: to have nothing to do with; unrelated
column5: This matter has nothing to do with me.
column6: 无关 is "unrelated": 和…无关 (has nothing to do with …), 无关的人 (an unrelated person).

column5: He feels helpless and has no choice but to go himself.
column6: 无奈 is to have no choice, or helpless. It can also mean "but unfortunately": 很无奈 (feeling helpless), 无奈没有时间 (but unfortunately there is no time).

column5: There are countless stars in the sky.
column6: 无数 is countless: 无数次 (countless times), 无数的人 (countless people).

column4: 妈妈对孩子有无限的爱。
column5: A mother has endless love for her child.
column6: 无限 is without limit: 无限的爱 (endless love), 无限的可能 (unlimited possibilities).

column4: 这张票过期了，已经无效了。
column5: This ticket has expired and is already invalid.
column6: 无效 is not effective or not valid: 对他无效 (ineffective for him), 已经无效 (already invalid).

column5: She likes learning dance.
column6: 舞蹈 is dance as an art: 学舞蹈 (to learn dance), 舞蹈老师 (a dance teacher). The verb phrase is 跳舞.

column5: He has studied Chinese martial arts since he was a child.
column6: 武术 is martial arts: 学武术 (to learn martial arts), 中国武术 (Chinese martial arts).

column4: 第一次走上舞台，她很紧张。
column5: Walking onto the stage for the first time, she feels very nervous.
column6: 舞台 is a stage: 舞台上 (on the stage), 走上舞台 (to walk onto the stage).

column5: The flowers in the garden are colourful.
column6: 五颜六色 means "of many colours": 五颜六色的花 (colourful flowers). Literally it is "five colours, six colours".

column5: There is heavy fog this morning.
column6: 雾 is fog: 大雾 (heavy fog), 有雾 (to be foggy).

column5: Prices in this city are very high.
column6: 物价 is the general level of prices: 物价高 (prices are high), 物价上涨 (prices rise). The price of one thing is 价格.

column5: His physics results are very good.
column6: 物理 is physics, as a school subject: 学物理 (to study physics), 物理老师 (a physics teacher).

column4: 下车时，请带好自己的物品。
column5: When getting off, please take your own belongings.
column6: 物品 is articles or things: 个人物品 (personal belongings), 重要物品 (important items).

column5: If there is a problem, you can ask the property management.
column6: 物业 is the property management of a residential building: 找物业 (to contact the property management), 物业公司 (a property management company).

column5: Water is an important substance.
column6: 物质 is matter, a substance, or material things: 一种物质 (a substance), 物质生活 (material life).

column5: I want to eat Western food today.
column6: 西餐 is Western food: 吃西餐 (to eat Western food), 西餐的味道 (the taste of Western food).

column4: 我喝果汁的时候用吸管。
column5: I use a straw when I drink juice.
column6: 吸管 is a drinking straw: 一根吸管 (a straw), 用吸管喝 (to drink with a straw).

column5: Plants absorb water and sunlight.
column6: 吸收 is to take in: 吸收水 (to absorb water), 吸收知识 (to take in knowledge).

column5: He wore a suit today.
column6: 西装 is a Western-style suit: 穿西装 (to wear a suit), 一套西装 (a suit).

column5: This play is very interesting.
column6: 戏 is a play or an opera: 看戏 (to watch a play), 一出戏 (a play), 演戏 (to act in a play).

column4: 这件事的细节我不太清楚。
column5: I am not very clear about the details of this matter.
column6: 细节 is a small detail: 注意细节 (to pay attention to details), 很多细节 (many details).

column5: She likes watching drama very much.
column6: 戏剧 is drama as an art form: 看戏剧 (to watch drama), 学戏剧 (to study drama). A single play is 戏.

column5: This system is very easy to use.
column6: 系统 is a system: 电脑系统 (a computer system), 考试系统 (an exam system).

column4: 我在网上下载了一个游戏。
column5: I downloaded a game from the internet.
column6: 下载 is to download: 下载软件 (to download software), 免费下载 (a free download).

column5: He went to three countries one after another.
column6: 先后 means "one after another", and also "the order of first and later": 先后到 (to arrive one after another), 先后顺序 (the order).

column4: 这家医院的设备很先进。
column5: The equipment in this hospital is very advanced.
column6: 先进 is advanced, ahead of others: 先进的技术 (advanced technology), 先进的国家 (an advanced country).

column5: I am not very busy today; I am free.
column6: 闲 is not busy, with free time: 很闲 (very free). In speech 有空 (to be free) is more common.

column4: 穿上红衣服，她显得很漂亮。
column5: With red clothes on, she looks very pretty.
column6: 显得 is "to look, to seem", followed by an adjective: 显得很高兴 (to look very happy), 显得年轻 (to look young).

column5: He obviously does not want to go.
column6: 显然 is "obviously": 很显然 (very obvious), 显然不对 (obviously wrong).

column4: 手机上显示现在是三点。
column5: The phone shows that it is three o'clock now.
column6: 显示 is to show or display: 显示时间 (to show the time), 结果显示 (the result shows).

column5: He works in a small county.
column6: 县 is a county, a unit smaller than a city: 一个县 (a county), 县里 (in the county).
